reviews.comment: Kind professor, easy to access, willing to help students, and genuinely interested in math. Some topics he sped through. If this is your first calculus class it will take more effort to succeed. Lectures were boring at times. Sometimes he went on tangents and overcomplicated things. He is relatively new to teaching, but puts in effort even so.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall he's a pretty nice professor, but teaches the class almost like a review. Lecture can get boring as he keeps on going with the material and never really stops to take questions. He also isn't very good at responding to emails so it can get hard to communicate with him. If you do take his class try to attend Prof Schrader's as it helped me.

Dr. Leung is a nice person, but his lectures didn't work too well for me. He writes on the whiteboard and his writing is hard to read at times. He occasionally doesn't cover some material needed for the homework or exams. He answers questions in a patient way, but his teaching is fast-paced; he makes concepts and problems seem harder than they are.

Joseph is a really great teacher, I would really recommend taking him. He has very clear lectures, is good at answering questions, and posts his lectures online. He is very wholesome, funny, and understanding. Makes Math-151 seem easy.
